en.name: Canned anchovies
en.summary: Canned anchovies are small fish cured in salt and packed in oil, and the unopened tin is one of the longest-lived things in a kitchen — about 5 years in the cupboard. Once opened they become an ordinary refrigerated perishable, good for 3–4 days. Out of the can, they freeze for about 2 months.
en.pantry: An unopened tin or jar keeps about 5 years in a cool, dry cupboard, away from the cooker and out of direct sun. Salt and the sealed can do the work, so no refrigeration is needed until the seal is broken. Do not keep a tin that is bulging, leaking, badly dented along a seam or rusted through — those are the signs that the seal has failed, and no amount of cooking makes that safe.
en.fridge: Once the tin is open, treat anchovies as a fresh perishable: transfer them with their oil to a small sealed glass jar and refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, using them within 3–4 days. Never store them in the opened can — the metal taints the fish once air reaches it. Keep the fillets submerged in their oil, which slows both drying and oxidation, and top up with a little olive oil if they are not covered.
en.freezer: Remove the anchovies from the can before freezing. Pack them flat with their oil in a small sealed container at −18 °C (0 °F), where they hold about 2 months of good quality; frozen food kept at that temperature stays safe indefinitely, so this is a flavour limit. Freezing them in small, single-recipe portions makes sense, since most dishes ask for only two or three fillets.
en.thawing: Thaw anchovies in the fridge, or simply drop a frozen fillet straight into a hot pan or sauce where it will melt. Do not thaw them at room temperature.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly rusted tin — discard without opening
A rancid, paint-like or sharply sour smell rather than a clean salty-savoury one
Fillets gone mushy, grey or slimy
Mould in the jar, or oil that has turned cloudy and off-smelling
tips: Decant leftovers into a small glass jar the moment the tin is open.
Keep the fillets covered in oil; add a splash more if needed.
Buy small tins if you use anchovies occasionally — a few days is not long.
Anchovy paste in a tube is the practical alternative for an occasional cook.

faq.q: How long do unopened canned anchovies last?
faq.a: About 5 years in a cool dry cupboard. Discard any tin that is bulging, leaking or badly rusted.

faq.q: How long do anchovies last once opened?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C or below, moved out of the can into a sealed glass jar and kept under their oil.
Yes, but take them out of the can first. Packed with their oil at −18 °C they hold about 2 months of good quality.

faq.q: Can you store anchovies in the opened tin?
faq.a: No. Once air reaches the metal the fish picks up a tinny taste. Transfer them to glass straight away.

zh.name: 鯷魚罐頭
zh.summary: 鯷魚罐頭是用鹽醃漬、再浸在油裡的小魚，未開罐是廚房裡最耐放的東西之一——櫥櫃裡大約 5 年。一旦開罐，它就變成普通的冷藏易腐食品，只有 3～4 天。把魚從罐子裡取出後冷凍，大約可放 2 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭或玻璃瓶放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃大約 5 年，遠離爐火與日曬。保存靠的是鹽和密封的容器，所以在封口打開之前都不需要冷藏。罐身鼓起、滲漏、接縫嚴重凹陷或鏽穿的就不要留——那是密封失效的訊號，再怎麼加熱都無法補救。
zh.fridge: 開罐之後，鯷魚就要當成新鮮易腐食品：連同油一起移到小玻璃罐密封，放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在 3～4 天內用完。不要直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱——空氣一進去，金屬就會讓魚帶金屬味。讓魚柳泡在油裡，可以同時減緩乾掉和氧化，油不夠就補一點橄欖油。
zh.freezer: 要冷凍請先把鯷魚從罐頭取出。連油一起攤平裝進小密封盒放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2 個月；食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，所以這是風味期限。建議按「一道菜的份量」分小包冷凍，因為多數食譜只用得到兩三片。
zh.thawing: 鯷魚請放冷藏解凍，或直接把冷凍的魚柳丟進熱鍋或醬汁裡讓它化開。不要放在室溫解凍。
spoilage: 罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重生鏽——不要開，直接丟掉
聞起來有油耗味、油漆味或強烈酸味，而不是乾淨的鹹香
罐子裡長霉，或油變混濁並有異味
tips: 一開罐就立刻把剩下的移到小玻璃罐。
讓魚柳保持泡在油裡，不夠就再加一點。
偶爾才用的話請買小罐——幾天並不長。
偶爾下廚的人，管狀鯷魚醬是很實際的替代品。

faq.q: 未開封的鯷魚罐頭可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃大約 5 年。罐身鼓起、滲漏或嚴重生鏽的請直接丟掉。

faq.q: 鯷魚開罐後可以放多久？
faq.a: 移到密封玻璃罐、泡在油裡，放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
可以，但要先從罐頭取出。連油密封放 −18 °C，風味大約可維持 2 個月。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。空氣接觸金屬後，魚會帶上金屬味。請立刻換到玻璃容器。
